sections.heading: One Brand Family Across the Whole Tray
sections.text: QSR Brand Systems One Brand Family Across the Whole Tray Fast-food branding lives or dies on the tray moment: if the burger box, sleeve and cup don't match, the brand looks assembled from a catalogue. We produce the set as one print family — shared dielines, shared inks, one lot — so burgundy on the bucket equals burgundy on the bag. Function is per-item engineered: burger boxes vent steam so buns don't sweat; fry sleeves hold oil for 30+ minutes without ghosting; buckets carry grease-barrier board rated for hot chicken. All food-contact surfaces meet FDA/EU migration standards. Related formats: the food-grade pizza & bakery box and carry-out gable boxes . Full category on the food packaging page .

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions Can I order the whole set matched? Yes — the set prints as one family with shared inks and one production lot, so colours match across box, sleeve, bucket, bag and cup. How long do fry sleeves hold oil? Standard spec holds 30+ minutes without ghosting; heavier barriers are available for delivery-first operations. Do burger boxes prevent soggy buns? Vent channels release steam while keeping heat — specced for 20–30 minute delivery windows. Are materials food-safe and eco options available? All food-contact inks and coatings meet FDA/EU migration standards; PE-free barrier versions suit compost streams. What is the MOQ? 500 pcs per item; mixed-set orders are standard.
